tx:
Worshipping the Ectofuntus with the required materials always yields 5 ecto-tokens and a varying amount of Prayer experience that depends on the remains used. Bonus experience will not be consumed when worshipping at the Ectofuntus.
Players can worship as many as 511 times before having to claim their earned ecto-tokens. To redeem the ecto-tokens, players must talk to a ghost disciple with a ghostspeak amulet equipped (if the player has not completed all the hard Morytania achievements), or choose the "Collect" option on a ghost disciple (no amulet needed).
The maximum number of Ecto-tokens that can be held by the ghost disciple is 2,555, at which point the player is forced to collect the tokens before being allowed to worship the Ectofuntus again.

• Purchasing pieces of the First age outfit for 1,000 ecto-tokens each from the shady ghost.
• Purchasing ale yeast from Metarialus for 5 ecto-tokens. However, this may also be bought from Blandebir for only 25 coins.
• Entry to Port Phasmatys prior to completion of the Ghosts Ahoy for 2 tokens each time.
▸ Quests
One quest requires ecto-tokens:
• Animal Magnetism - 20
In the following quests, ecto-tokens are required to pass through the barrier into Port Phasmatys, but are not absolutely required as it is possible to enter Port Phasmatys by taking a charter ship.
• Ghosts Ahoy - 6
• Making History - 2 (Without completion of Ghosts Ahoy)
• One of a Kind - 2 (Without completion of Ghosts Ahoy)
• Cabin Fever - 2 (Without completion of Ghosts Ahoy)
